rawContent: When you say #BlackLivesMatter , that should mean more than speaking out against #MurderByCop . That should also extend to stamping out Black On Black Crime. If we don't love each other, our message is somewhat muted. The #BLM thing seems to have lost some steam.

The #JacobBlakeShooting is living proof that the establishment behind police brutality and white supremacy DOES NOT take #BlackLivesMatter seriously. What needs to be done to MAKE THEM UNDERSTAND that this isn't gonna be tolerated anymore??

We're at the point where #BlackLivesMatter has become a slogan with no TEETH. To those protesting, are you ready for REVOLUTION?? Anything short of that is just noise. #JacobBlakeShooting #JacobBlakeProtests

Where is SOLIDARITY EVERY DAY?? People Of Color have been in a perpetual state of war for DECADES! It always takes a "shock to the system" to get us to WAKE UP. WHY?? Make #BlackLivesMatter more than just a phrase!
